name: auto-pilot
description: Drive the Oniesoft test platform from Cursor: generate web/API/mobile/performance test cases, run them (native mobile via Appium + self-healing semantic locators), and analyze failures.

PLATFORM_API_KEY.title: API key
PLATFORM_API_KEY.description: Your personal Oniesoft API key. Generate one in the platform under Users > API Keys. Sent as the x-api-key header on every call.

PLATFORM_API_URL.title: Platform API URL
PLATFORM_API_URL.description: Base URL of the Oniesoft platform API. Leave blank to use the per-project config.json value.

BACKEND_URL.title: Backend URL
BACKEND_URL.description: Base URL of the Oniesoft backend. Leave blank to use the per-project config.json value.
